claims.statement: The two merge commits and three canonical files exist with observable Git blob SHAs.
The prototype source implements deterministic routing, reverse reconstruction and SHA-256 comparison.
Compact routes may reduce materialized bytes for corpora with sufficient structural reuse.
Field-route-flow-control correspondence is an architectural mapping, not a physical identity.
Merge, documentation and source-code presence do not prove benchmark performance, replication or physical unification.
Current runtime execution, generated binary artifacts, independent replication and complete Drive pagination are absent.
